# Mesita

Mesita is an AI-native platform for going out: discovery, reservations, ordering, rewards and payments in one app, for the guest's whole night and the place's whole funnel. This repository is the whole product: five web apps, two mobile apps, the Supabase backend and the brand assets, each folder an independent install root.

How Mesita works, and how it is allowed to change, is written in Notion, not here: [Rules](https://www.notion.so/Rules-3d9a9bf37a5280aaab2ed8af665485f7) is the law, [Docs](https://www.notion.so/Docs-3bfa9bf37a52801e891ec3407d717273) is the knowledge. Both are internal. Agents boot from `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`; the root one is the map of the repo.

This repository is public for transparency. Contributions are not accepted; work is tracked in Linear. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Security reports: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
